content:
Run "npm test." first.
Run 'pnpm lint,' then stop.
Run *yarn build;* now.
Run _npx tsc:_ now.
Run "cargo check?" now.
Run 'docker ps!' now.
note: A word ending in clause punctuation followed by `"`, `'`, `*` or `_` still ends the clause, and the punctuation goes with those trailing characters, while one leading quote or emphasis character before the runner is ignored; a detector that only accepts the punctuation as the very last character would run on to the end of the line.
